title: Guide for the Use of the International System of Units (SI)
source: Ambler Thompson and Barry N. Taylor, Guide for the Use of the International System of Units (SI), NIST Special Publication 811, 2008 Edition, sections 6.1 and 7, read 2026-10-08.

rules.text: Unit symbols stay the same in the plural: 75 cm, not 75 cms.
A unit symbol takes no period unless it ends a sentence.
The solidus is not repeated in one unit without parentheses: m/s², not m/s/s.
Unit symbols and unit names are not used together: km/h or kilometres per hour, not km per hour.
Units are never abbreviated: s not sec, min not mins, h not hrs, L not lit, A not amps.
A space is left between the numerical value and the unit symbol, the degree Celsius included; none for the degree, minute and second of a plane angle.
A space is left between the number and the symbol %, and the symbol is used rather than the word.
The value of a quantity is expressed in one unit.
